verdict.rationale: The evidence points toward data portability. Query responses can be returned in a chosen output format via the X-ClickHouse-Format header and FORMAT clause. Cloud backups can be exported to your own cloud account. ClickHouse is open source and can run self-hosted as a single binary, and it markets data-lake access 'without lock in'. However, no evidence explicitly documents bulk export of all data into named open formats (e.g., Parquet/CSV) or a migration-off workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-dataset export to open formats like Parquet/CSV, a documented exit/migration-out path from Cloud, independent corroboration of export.
